The company's net debt decreased, and its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved.

title: Sebi aims to relax offshore fund investor-disclosure rules as appeals grow: Report
description: India's market regulator is set to simplify disclosure requirements for offshore funds to entice more long-term foreign investment. The proposed adjustments include extending the disclosure timelines for fresh investors and increasing the thresholds for reporting specific investor information. These initiatives emerged in response to legal challenges and complaints from investors, seeking to create a more conducive environment for capital influx.

title: Global Market: Goldman Sachs sees Brent crude trading at $80-$90 until Iran conflict outlook clears
description: Goldman Sachs forecasts Brent crude prices between $80 and $90 per barrel. This range persists until clarity emerges on US-Iran nuclear talks. Physical oil markets are tightening significantly due to reduced flows from key regions. Gulf oil exports have dropped substantially from pre-war levels. Russian crude supplies also show a recent decline, impacting global availability.

This surge followed a strong earnings report and increased investor confidence in artificial intelligence. Amazon anticipates substantial capital expenditures to meet future artificial intelligence demand. Other tech giants like Apple and Microsoft also saw their market values increase.
